messages:
alex_cs: FYI — GreenLeaf (acct GL-220) just opened a support ticket: service suspended after dunning notice. They say PO 450987 was submitted last Thursday and payment confirmation (payment_confirmation.pdf) attached. Ticket #12345. Can collections confirm why suspension happened?
jordan_collections: looking into it. do we have the PO attached to their account? any tax/VAT flags? :thinking_face:
maya_finance: checking invoice INV-2026-033. System shows invoice matched to customer but payment method is 'PO_PENDING'. Our ledger indicates a PO was received as an email, but not uploaded to the PO field in billing system so auto-dunning kicked in.
sam_ops: is the dunning/suspension automated based purely on PO field presence? could be a ruleset that requires PO-number + VAT ID to avoid auto-suspend for enterprise accounts.
jordan_collections: yeah our rule: if account tier = enterprise and payment_method != card && PO field empty => schedule suspension after 7 days. Invoice also flagged VAT_MISMATCH because invoice country != PO country.
alex_cs: customer insists they attached PO to support ticket but not to billing portal. they want immediate restore — customer is on a live rollout.
billing-bot: AUTOMATION: invoice INV-2026-033 status -> OVERDUE. Suspension executed 2026-03-14 13:02 UTC. Flag: PO_REQUIRED, VAT_MISMATCH.
maya_finance: quick repro commands: 
```
GET /internal/billing/accounts/GL-220
GET /internal/billing/invoices/INV-2026-033?expand=payments,po
```
shows po_field = null, payments = []. email_attachments contain 1 item: payment_confirmation.pdf.
jordan_collections: proposed immediate action: manual override to restore service for 72h while CS helps customer attach PO in portal and provides VAT ID. I can do override if finance approves.
sam_ops: techn & risk OK for 72h override; we'll add temporary entitlement and a tag to automatically revoke if no PO attached by 72h. I'll run commands: 
```
POST /internal/entitlements/restore {"account":"GL-220","ttl_hours":72,"reason":"Collections manual override - PO in progress"}
```
maya_finance: approve temporary restore. collections please record waiver: require updated PO upload + VAT certificate. Also add note in invoice: payment_confirmation.pdf accepted as evidence but not record of PO number; need proper PO to close dunning.
jordan_collections: done. manual restore executed at 1779003000. Added follow-up task in Asana and flagged for attorney review if dispute escalates.
alex_cs: customer notified, they uploaded PO to portal and sent VAT reg number in thread. they asked for retroactive days — we should handle credit manually.
maya_finance: please escalate credit request to finance-credits@redwood.com with invoice ID and days. Collections will hold suspension for 7 days after PO processed to avoid recurrence.
jordan_collections: will follow up with customer to confirm PO number matches invoice and close ticket. Closing slack thread after 72h if everything resolved. :white_check_mark:
